fields.description: Issue features editorials and political commentary on Dade County and Miami Beach politics, including criticism of state representatives over local-option pari-mutuel racing legislation and a proposed Miami Beach county referendum. Includes discussion of Florida Power & Light Company and utility/holding-company issues, a Southern Bell Telephone and Telegraph Company piece on taxes and telephone costs, local civic complaints (city parcel advertising charges, transportation to Coral Gables), and coverage of upcoming Lions convention activities. Also contains entertainment and nightlife notices, sports/boxing promotions, humor columns (including "Little Geraldine" and "Sammeh of Minsk Gabairnyeh"), letters to the editor, and local business advertising.
